project_overview.project_name: Project Rebuild MVP – Base NFT + Referral Engine + Fiat On-Ramp
project_overview.project_summary: This software / digital product project centers on Project Rebuild MVP – Base NFT + Referral Engine + Fiat On-Ramp. The formal job description is sparse, so the conversation and delivered artifacts are the primary evidence for reconstructing the engagement. The work sits mainly in Blockchain / Web3, Web, Mobile & Software Dev, Web Development. Stable project themes include authentication and access, administration and reporting, payments and billing, referral or affiliate tracking, nft issuance and ownership, gamification and prize selection, analytics and reporting. The available evidence includes 824 conversation messages, 68 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .pdf, .md, .sol, .json, .example, .yml, .lock, .toml formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For engineering onboarding, the key task is to understand the product workflows, component boundaries, integrations, data responsibilities, and the evidence level behind each implementation claim before changing code. Included source files provide direct evidence about implementation structure, dependencies, testing, and developer workflow.

technical_constraints: Small Block ($2,500 pool → 5 × $500 draw): Draw only from Small Block Tickets issued since the last small block.
Big Block ($100,000 pool → 5 × $20,000 draw): Draw only from Big Block Tickets issued since the last big block.
Email-based auth for dashboard access (referrals, tickets, prizes)—ties to fiat users without wallets.
You earn them only by getting people to mint with your code (1 Small + 1 Big per successful referral).
Only if you want affiliate commissions paid out or to trade the NFT later.
